A '''starship''' was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] [[Rianna Saren]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was destroyed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] when [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] shot it down and it crashed in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="LA" />
